posts.text:
New flagstone patio by the pool in Hallsville, TX.

This family wanted a spot to sit around a fire at night now that summer is winding down, so our crew built a rounded flagstone patio off the end of their pool deck.

We started with chopped stone borders, set by hand to a string line and checked with a level so the edge stays true. Inside the border went a crushed limestone base, raked out solid and even. The flagstone they picked went on top, with every piece fit by hand and the joints filled.

See the video and every photo from this job on our site.
